Probabilities are subjective estimates based on insider reporting, national and local coverage, team performance, contracts and buyout costs, and institutional context. They are editorial judgments, not outputs of a statistical model.

Program tiers are subjective assessments of head-coaching job desirability, informed by football resources, recruiting geography, conference economics and stability, fan support and tradition, and sustainable competitive potential. [See the ranking research, framework, and supporting data](program-rankings.qmd#how-to-read-these-rankings).
